Notify me if it is not ready after thirty seconds; retry reading twice on failure. Preserve the original file and build the complete flow.

Finish on success; retry twice on failure, then notify me. Store it beside the current configuration and avoid duplicates. Choose the implementation and connect the states.
建表成功 → 写入数据 → 校验完成；失败进入重试: Create table → write → verify, with bounded retries
创建一个数据库初始化状态机：初始化、写入数据、校验完成、重试、失败五个状态。在: Create five states: Initialize, Write data, Complete, Retry and Failed. Use FreeSql and SQLite at D:\AlcyoneDemo\data\orders.db. Define OrderRecord with integer primary key Id and string Name. The initialization condition must create and verify the table before transitioning to Write data. Idempotently write Id=1 and Name=Example, verify the record, then enter Complete. Save real errors and retry at most three times before entering Failed. Restore NuGet, compile and bind all actions and conditions, and connect all branches. Execute database work in the state machine.
整数低于阈值触发；回升后恢复，避免重复操作: Threshold trigger, recovery and duplicate suppression
使用已有 OCR 字典建立库存监控流程：监控、低库存处理、等待恢复、识别异常四个: Use an existing OCR dictionary for four states: Monitor, Low stock, Wait for recovery and Recognition error. Only an integer OCR value at or below 10 triggers Low stock; store the value and log one alert. Wait until the integer value reaches 20 before returning to Monitor. Failed recognition or noninteger values go to Recognition error; valid recognition restores monitoring. Preserve the recognition library, avoid repeated alerts during recovery, and connect all states. Ask which dictionary to use only if needed.
文件出现且大小稳定 → 处理；超时走异常分支: File exists and stops changing → process; timeout branch
创建文件监听状态机：等待文件、确认稳定、处理文件、完成、超时五个状态。监听 D:: Create Wait for file, Check stability, Process, Complete and Timeout states for D:\AlcyoneDemo\inbox\orders.csv. When the file appears, check its size twice one second apart; process only when both sizes match and are positive. Read the row count into a variable without deleting or overwriting the input file. Finish on success; after 30 seconds waiting or checking stability, take the timeout branch and log the reason. Use cancellable async conditions and connect all cards.
成功、失败、超时分别判断；三次失败后等待人工: Separate success, failure and timeout branches; three retries
用现有识别项目生成登录流程：等待登录页、提交登录、确认结果、重试、人工接管、已登: Build Wait for login page, Submit, Confirm result, Retry, Manual intervention and Logged in using existing recognition items. Submit only once after recognizing the login page. Confirm through separate success, error and ten-second timeout outputs. Log failures and retry at most three times before stopping clicks in Manual intervention; retry when the user sets continueLogin=true. On success, enter Logged in and reset the retry count. Ask for missing recognition items; never invent credentials or recognition data. Generate needed scripts and connect all conditions and routes.
